summary: Lantern Pharma filed an 8-K regarding a registered direct offering and concurrent private placement. The company issued 1,454,175 common shares at $2.06/share and pre-funded warrants for 681,748 shares at $2.0599, raising ~$4.4M. Additionally, it issued 5-year purchase warrants exercisable at $2.27 for up to 2,135,923 shares (6-month lockout). Investors are subject to a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap, waivable to 9.99%. The company must file a resale registration statement within 30 days and use best efforts to make it effective within 60 days. This is a capital-raising transaction with a participation right clause, not a typical special situation. What to watch: potential dilution from the warrants and any AI subsidiary spin-off plans.
